component.name: SquadAir
component.summary: Ultra-lightweight P2P voice chat and 1080p60 screen sharing

description.p: SquadAir is a fast, native desktop voice chat and screen-sharing app built in pure Rust for competitive gamers and squads who want crisp, low-latency comms without Electron bloat, accounts, or central media servers.

ul.li: Direct peer-to-peer encrypted UDP transport using ChaCha20-Poly1305 with client-side BLAKE3 keys and zero accounts
Free 1080p 60fps screen sharing with atomic 64x64 tile updates, XOR-FEC, and direct GPU shader presentation
10 ms Opus voice DSP with WebRTC AEC3 echo cancellation, RNNoise suppression, and adaptive jitter profiles
2-second squad connect via 6-digit SPAKE2 voice codes, decentralized X25519 friends, LAN rooms with automatic host failover, and squad:// invite links
Encrypted room chat with inline clipboard screenshots and BLAKE3-verified P2P swarm file transfers

screenshot.caption: Active voice room with 1080p60 screen sharing, P2P telemetry, and encrypted chat
Lobby with 6-digit SPAKE2 voice code, LAN discovery, and X25519 friends

description.p: Native pure-Rust P2P voice chat, 1080p60 screen sharing, and Microsoft Store packaging support.
